jobs.description:
About the Role
At Providend, we believe that technology should serve people — our colleagues, our advisers, and ultimately the families we are privileged to work with. As we grow, we are building more of our own software and internal systems, and we need a passionate, commercially-minded Product Manager to take ownership of that journey.
 This is not a role for someone who simply takes instructions and manages timelines. We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about outcomes, who proactively seeks better ways of doing things, and who can bridge the world of business and technology with clarity and conviction. If you thrive in an environment where your ideas matter and your work creates real impact, we would love to meet you.

 What You will Do
 1. Define and Measure Value
 Define ROI metrics and success criteria for every system before development begins, and track outcomes post-launch.
 Evaluate whether existing tools are delivering their intended value, and recommend improvements or retirement where appropriate.
 Connect technology investment decisions to clear, measurable business outcomes.
 Maintain visibility overdevelopment costs and work within agreed budget parameters, balancing ambition with financial discipline.
 2. Understand the Business Deeply
 Work closely with stakeholders across the Group to uncover real needs, pain points, and opportunities — not just surface-level requests.
 Translate business requirements into clear product specifications that your technology team can act on confidently.
 Facilitate workshops, interviews, and reviews to ensure shared understanding at every stage.
 Evaluate and recommend third-party tools or SaaS platforms where building internally is not the right answer, and manage vendor relationships where applicable.
 3. Lead with Initiative, Not Just Process
 Go beyond gathering requirements — actively propose alternative approaches, challenge assumptions, and surface solutions the business may not yet have considered.
 Identify opportunities to automate workflows, reduce manual work, and improve how our teams operate day to day.
 Think cross-system: understand how different platforms and data flows connect, and ensure new systems integrate sensibly with what already exists.
 Stay curious about industry trends and emerging tools that could benefit the Group.
 4. Deliver with the Technology Team
 Own the product roadmap and prioritise the backlog based on business value, effort, and strategic fit.
 Partner closely with developers, architects, and QA to ensure requirements are well understood and faithfully implemented.
 Lead end-to-end delivery — managing scope, timelines, risks, and communication with stakeholders throughout.
 Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation, system specifications, and user guides — ensuring knowledge is never locked in someone’s head.
 5. Build with Compliance and Security in Mind
 Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure all systems adhere to relevant MAS guidelines, PDPA requirements, and internal data governance policies.
 Embed privacy-by-design and security-by-design principles into every product from the outset — not as an afterthought.
 Ensure appropriate access controls, audit trails, and data handling practices are defined as part of system requirements.
 Proactively flag regulatory or compliance considerations during product planning, before they become costly problems downstream.
 6.  Champion User Experience
 Advocate for good design in everything we build — systems that are intuitive, efficient, and a pleasure to use.
 Apply a discerning eye for UI and UX when reviewing prototypes and builds, raising issues early and suggesting practical improvements.
 Involve end-users in usability testing and weave their feedback meaningfully into the product cycle.
 7.  Drive Adoption and Manage Change
 Own the rollout plan for every system launch — including communications, training, and support materials for end-users.
 Anticipate and manage resistance to change, working with team leads and stakeholders to bring people along on the journey.
 Track adoption metrics post-launch and act on low uptake proactively, rather than assuming a shipped feature equals a used one.
 Manage the full product lifecycle thoughtfully — including versioning, release planning, and eventual sunset or migration when systems need to be replaced.
 To succeed in this role, you will be someone who:
 Brings the Right Experience
 Has a minimum of 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in an equivalent role — ideally within an organisation that builds software internally.
 Has a demonstrated track record of delivering products or systems that achieved real, measurable business outcomes.
 Is comfortable working within Agile, Scrum, or iterative delivery frameworks.
 Has experience managing or coordinating third-party vendors or SaaS platforms alongside internally developed systems.
 Holds a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, PMP, PMI-ACP) are a bonus.
 Has the Skills to Make an Impact
 Can translate complex business needs into clear, actionable product requirements —without losing the nuance.
 Communicates with confidence and clarity, whether presenting to leadership or working through a technical problem with a developer.
 Thinks commercially, with a strong sense of how technology investments connect to business value.
 Is outcomes-focused: measures success by real-world impact, not by features shipped.
 Is proficient in product and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar).
 Has enough working knowledge of software development and system integrations to hold informed, grounded conversations with engineering teams.
 Has a genuine appreciation for UX and UI principles, and an eye for when something just does not feel right.
 Understands the importance of documentation and treats it as part of the job, not a chore left for later.
 Brings the Right Character
 Is proactive and self-driven — you do not wait to be told there is a problem; you are already working on the solution.
 Is a strong team player who can work with diverse stakeholders across the business with patience and good humour.
 Possesses integrity, accountability, and the drive to see things through.
 Cares about the people who will use the systems you build — not just the systems themselves.
 Approaches compliance and data responsibility seriously, understanding that in a financial services context, trust is everything.
 Preferred Background
 Has experience in financial services, professional services, or a multi-entity Group structure.
 Is familiar with MAS regulations, PDPA, or data governance frameworks relevant to financial advisory firms.
 Is familiar with data analytics, reporting dashboards, or business intelligence tools.
 Has exposure to low-code / no-code platforms and the judgement to know when to use them.
 Has experience with system integration concepts (APIs, data pipelines, middleware) at a product level.

jobs.title: Product Manager SCF - Business Intelligence and Strategy
jobs.location: MARINA BAY FINANCIAL CENTRE, MARINA BOULEVARD, D01 Marina, Raffles Place, People's Park, Cecil, Singapore
jobs.description:
Job Summary
 As a Product Manager, Business Intelligence & Strategy Analyst, you will support the global SCF (Supply Chain Finance) business by tracking performance metrics, delivering analytical insights, and assisting in the business planning. You will work closely with global product managers and regional cluster Trade teams and provide performance support to the Global Head and the management team.
 Key Responsibilities
 Business Intelligence Management and Strategy
 • Maintain performance dashboards and update revenue scorecards used in regular reviews such as the Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Portfolio Reviews (QPR)
 • Prepare regular and ad hoc presentation for internal and senior management using MS Excel and PowerPoint.
 • Support strategic projects by extracting insights from data sets across addressable market revenue pools, pipeline, client segments, and product usage.
 • Coordinate across teams to consolidate and validate data inputs related to product launches, enhancements, and client usage trends.

 Performance and KPI Monitoring
 • Provide performance reporting and business insights to Central Product Team, supporting day to day and strategic initiatives.
 • Work closely with the Central Product Team by consolidating inputs, preparing review materials, and helping track execution of key deliverables.
 • Serve as the single point of contact for data consolidation ensuring consistent reporting of exposures
 • Develop consistent reporting dashboard

 Commercialisation and Execution Support
 • Track progress of new product initiatives ensuring timely follow up and closures.
 • Help define and track key KPIs at product, client, and country level.
 • Monitor pipeline activity and align it with metrics and revenue goals.
 • Consolidate feedback and inputs from Clusters, Trade Sales, Client Managers, and Relationship Manager to identify areas of process or data improvement.
 Risk and Governance Support
 • Track compliance of initiatives with internal governance policies (e.g. timely exposure of action items, reporting exceptions)
 • Engage and escalate material red flags that arise in the transaction flow.
 • Liaise with key control functions such as Operations, Credit, Legal, and Compliance to mitigate operational and conduct risks related to the product line.

 Leadership and Engagement Coordination
 • Work closely with the Global Trade Business Manager together with the Cluster Head for any business-driven initiatives or activities.
 • Assist in the logistics and preparation of performance forums, planning sessions, and any events under the Cluster.
 • Help ensure business intelligence insights are shared within the Cluster and used in ongoing management engagement.

 Regulatory & Business Conduct*
 • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
 • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
 • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
 Our Ideal Candidate
 •	Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline
 •	6+ years’ experience in banking/financial services, business analytics, or a similar role; experience in Trade Finance or Transaction Banking.
 •	Demonstrated strategic mindset, with experience in strategy roles within a bank and/or a consulting firm.
 •	Ability to develop high-quality presentations and clearly communicate key messages to senior stakeholders.
 •	Strong data analytics capability, combined with sound project management skills.
 •	Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and support regional and global initiatives.
 •	Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables under tight timelines.
 •	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage internal stakeholders professionally.
 •	Analytical mindset with advanced proficiency in data and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint) and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
 Role Specific Technical Competencies
 •	Microsoft Excel, Powerpoint, Business Intelligence
 •	Trade Finance
 •	Knowledge of Product Line
 •	Industry knowledge
 •	Financial Statement Analysis
 •	Organisational Skills
 About Standard Chartered
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
 Together we:
 • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
 • Never settle , continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
 • Are better together , we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
 What we offer
 In line with our Fair Pay Charter , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
 • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
 • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
 • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
 • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
 • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
 • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.
 Recruitment Assessments
 Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
 Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Citi's Services organization provides an integrated suite of innovative and tailored cash management and
 trade and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector
 organizations. Citi's Trade & Working Capital business is the market leader in delivering global trade and
 working capital financing solutions across sectors.

About KGiSL:

 KG Information Systems Private Limited (KGiSL) is a leading Information Technology (IT) solutions and services provider catering to the global investment banks, insurance, healthcare, education and supply chain domains with offices in India, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Australia and the US. KGiSL is revolutionizing the process of Digital Transformation through world-class infrastructure and streamlined processes that creates innovative solutions and services. With the existing expertise in software consulting and staffing services, we are looking out for professionals who are interested to be part of this exciting journey and be involved in business development and sales.

 We are pleased to share an exciting Business Analyst opportunity with our prestigious client in Singapore.

 ROLE OVERVIEW
 We are seeking a domain-expert RPA Business Analyst with deep, hands-on knowledge of Reinsurance operations and a proven track record of delivering intelligent automation programmes using UiPath. This is a specialist role within our Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE), focused exclusively on the reinsurance and insurance value chain — from treaty and facultative processing to bordereau reconciliation, claims management, and regulatory reporting.
 The RPA BA will be the primary interface between reinsurance business stakeholders and the automation delivery team. You will own the end-to-end discovery, analysis, documentation, and governance of automation initiatives — producing artefacts to CoE standards while working closely with UiPath developers to ensure solutions are technically sound, compliant, and deliver measurable business value.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Process Discovery & Analysis
 • Lead structured process discovery workshops with underwriting, claims, finance, and reinsurance operations SMEs to capture end-to-end workflows
 • Analyse and document As-Is reinsurance processes across treaty, facultative, bordereau, claims, and cession accounting workflows
 • Assess automation feasibility, calculate complexity vs. benefit scores, and recommend processes for RPA, attended automation, or AI-assisted processing
 • Produce As-Is and To-Be process maps using BPMN notation (Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent) incorporating all exception paths and business rules
 • Identify and document data sources, system integrations, and dependencies including reinsurance platforms (RI3K, Sequel, Remetrica, Xuber, or equivalent)
 Documentation & Artefact Ownership
 • Author high-quality Process Definition Documents (PDDs), Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), and Solution Design Documents (SDDs) to CoE standards
 • Maintain a live automation register covering pipeline, in-flight, and production bots with version control, change logs, and ownership matrices
 • Produce and maintain operational runbooks, exception-handling guides, and escalation procedures for each deployed automation
 • Own UAT planning, test script authoring, execution coordination, defect tracking, and formal business sign-off documentation
 • Prepare change management communications and end-user training packs for automation go-lives across reinsurance operations
 • Deliver post-implementation benefits realisation reports tracking FTE savings, error rate reduction, SLA compliance, and ROI
 Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
 • Act as the primary point of contact for reinsurance business stakeholders throughout the automation lifecycle from discovery to hypercare
 • Present automation proposals, solution designs, and delivery updates to senior stakeholders including COO, CFO, and CUO level
 • Work closely with UiPath developers to validate technical designs against business requirements and ensure solution accuracy
 • Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit teams to ensure automations meet MAS regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks
 • Support the development and continuous improvement of CoE documentation standards, templates, and governance frameworks
 • Contribute to the quarterly automation pipeline review, prioritising opportunities based on strategic value and implementation complexity
 UiPath Platform & RPA Knowledge
 • Apply working knowledge of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework to validate technical designs and support developer decision-making
 • Understand UiPath Document Understanding capabilities to scope intelligent data extraction from reinsurance documents (bordereaux, slips, endorsements)
 • Define bot exception handling requirements, Orchestrator queue structures, and alerting thresholds in collaboration with the development team
 • Participate in code reviews and UAT execution with an appreciation of RPA development best practices
 • Support UiPath Process Mining or Task Mining exercises to objectively validate process discovery findings
 REINSURANCE DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
 This role requires substantive reinsurance domain expertise. Candidates must demonstrate knowledge across the following areas:
 Treaty Reinsurance
 • Quota share, surplus, and excess of loss (XL) treaty structures, premium calculation methodologies, and profit commission arrangements
 • Treaty bordereau processing: premium bordereau, claims bordereau, and cash call management across cedent portfolios
 • Treaty accounting cycle: cession entry, reinsurance premium payable/receivable, and intercompany settlement
 Facultative Reinsurance
 • Facultative submission workflow: risk assessment, slip preparation, capacity placement, and certificate issuance
 • Facultative premium and claims processing, including endorsement handling and cancellation workflows
 Claims & Finance Operations
 • Claims bordereau intake, IBNR reserve management, loss run generation, and reinsurance claims recoverable tracking
 • Cash calls, loss portfolio transfers, and commutation processing
 • Financial close processes: reinsurance entries, bordereau reconciliation, and management accounts preparation
 Regulatory & Market Knowledge
 • Familiarity with Singapore MAS regulatory framework for reinsurers and branches operating in Singapore
 • Understanding of Lloyd’s of London market operations, ACORD messaging standards, and market reform initiatives (Blueprint Two)
 • Working knowledge of IFRS 17 impact on reinsurance accounting and associated reporting automation opportunities
 • Awareness of data governance, data lineage, and reconciliation control requirements in a regulated reinsurance environment
 TECHNICAL & TOOLS EXPERIENCE
 • 5–8 years of Business Analyst experience, with a minimum of 3 years in the reinsurance or specialty insurance sector
 • Demonstrated experience delivering RPA automation programmes in a BA capacity, ideally using UiPath
 • Proficiency in BPMN process mapping tools: Visio, Lucidchart, Bizagi, or equivalent
 • Strong working knowledge of reinsurance platforms: RI3K, Sequel Eclipse, Remetrica, Xuber, or Majesco Treaty
 • Familiarity with core insurance/reinsurance systems and their data structures (policy admin, claims, finance ledger)
 • Proficiency with documentation and collaboration platforms: Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, or equivalent
 • Ability to read and interpret SQL queries and API specifications to validate integration designs
 • Experience with data analysis tools (Excel advanced, Power BI, or similar) for bordereau reconciliation and benefits tracking
 • Basic understanding of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework is required; hands-on development experience is a strong advantage
 DOCUMENTATION ARTEFACTS & OWNERSHIP
 The RPA BA will own or co-own the following artefacts across the automation delivery lifecycle:

 ELIGIBILITY & APPLICATION

 We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner to sit at the centre of the engagement and turn business ambiguity into clear, structured, build-ready product work.
 The role
 This is a senior BA role with Product Owner responsibilities. You will work directly with client stakeholders, PRVW delivery leads, design, and engineering to gather requirements, clarify scope, document workflows, and keep the delivery backlog build-ready through a fast-moving development cycle.
 You will own requirements quality and backlog content. That means working up to PO level on prioritisation, scope clarity, and product decisions delegated by the delivery leads, and down into granular detail on user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. You will convert conversations, workshops, workflows, business rules, and user needs into clear requirements and validation materials.

Together you will align backlog priorities, sprint scope, and stakeholder validation against the milestone plan. You will keep the requirements side clean so the build team can move quickly with confidence.
 Because this is a regulated financial services environment, documentation discipline matters. Requirements need to be clear, traceable, and suitable for enterprise delivery.
 This role expects regular face-to-face time with the client, in the region of a few days a week, for requirements workshops and validation sessions.
 How we work
 We are a startup and the environment reflects that. Expect a fast pace, priorities that shift as the build evolves, broad ownership, and direct access to the people making decisions. We stay flexible on working hours and where you work, organised around the fixed points that matter: client sessions, delivery milestones, and team coordination. In return we look for self-direction, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias to action.
 You will do well here if you are energised by autonomy and room to move at pace. The fixed hours, rigid structure, and layered process of a large bank or corporate are not how we operate.
 What you'll do
 •     Lead requirements gathering with client stakeholders, SMEs, operations, compliance, product, and engineering.

 •     Use AI tooling to accelerate documentation, story drafting, workflow mapping, and test case preparation while maintaining quality.
 What you'll bring
 •     Three to five years or more as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Product Manager, or hybrid BA/PO on software product builds, ideally in banking, insurance, wealth, advisory, or financial services.
 •     Proven ability to operate both at PO level and in granular BA detail on the same engagement.
 •     Experience working with active development teams in agile or iterative delivery environments.
 •     Proven ability to gather, structure, and document requirements for technical and non-technical audiences.

Their brand promise, Here for good, underlines their distinctive approach.

 In Bank’s Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB), we aim to be digital-first and data-driven, delivering enhanced client experiences, driving new wallet share and realizing untapped client value and market opportunities.
 Part of CIB’s Digital Channel Solutions (DCS), we are building a complete end-to-end, digital-first cash transacting and servicing journey across payments, collections, account services and relevant reporting requirements. We are passionate about developing and delivering Best in Class digital client experience through consistent, well designed, contextual user journeys across all our client touchpoints such as the web and mobile.
 The Business Analyst (BA) for cash digital channel is a role in the DCS team. Our Straight2Bank NextGen digital platform serves our global clients across our 45+ footprint markets.
 RESPONSIBILITIES
 Strategy
 Bank’s Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB) has embarked on an ambitious journey to revolutionize digital banking by building innovative digital platform & products that competes not just with the Financial Institutions but with the new breed of Fintech companies. Digital Channel Solutions (DCS) is the core team within the bank which champions this vision and is responsible to drive the digitization agenda with our corporate and institutional clients.
 Business
 As a Business Analyst, you will help deliver the next generation corporate & institutional banking platform. You will work with talented team members across Product Management, Technology and client service partners to develop your product all the way from a conceptual stage to the product launch
 Processes
 You will have a key role in building innovative product capabilities, influence change, commercialize capabilities and enable our global digital platform in 40+ countries. You will be responsible to take the ideas through implementation in Agile Methodology
 Key Responsibilities include:
 As the BA you will be responsible for supporting the product owners in performing in depth analysis on specific product requirements, specifically the Universal adaptor conversion utility (“UA”). This is a proprietary conversion utility which enables clients to submit their custom file formats and converts these file formats to bank’s proprietary file formats. You will be assessing the current utilisation of the UA, client behaviour in the product utilisation, risks associated with the product features, rollout of new substitute products, analysis on controls to managing the UA and engaging with our frontline (and relevant) teams to transit clients to new capabilities.
 Work with the business users to capture, analyse and prioritize business requirements in harmony with existing Straight2Bank NextGen cash functionalities.
 Translate business needs into technical user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams; need to have a good understanding of the various systems interfaces.
 Hands-on experience in requirements life cycle management in banking and financial domain. Should be able to manage requirements from inception to implementation across multiple systems interfaces.

 Ensure gaps in deliverables are identified early and addressed effectively.

 Over-see and steer time, cost, and quality of over-all solutions. Work with delivery and project services organizations as well as other technology and vendor organizations in ensuring requirements are transformed into effective solutions with-in cost, schedule, and quality - adhering to the bank’s standards, guidelines, and policies.
 People & Talent
 Collaborate with the team through example and build the appropriate culture and values with clients and with internal stakeholders
 You are expected to be a team player. You will engage actively with the product, implementation & client management, legal, compliance, operations and sales teams to create awareness of the new product features and encourage a participative attitude to elicit critical business requirements and ensure overall acceptance of the new process flows and the system functionalities
 Risk Management

 Perform risk assessments to ensure proper governance prior to product launch.
 Review applicable internal policies and procedures to prevent gaps against risk governance framework.
 Identify and mitigate risks related to product development, compliance, legal, and security teams. To have strong engagement and liaison with these teams to drive the regulatory approvals required to ensure Straight2bank Cash services remain compliant with banking and data protection laws.
 Ensure Country compliance on Group standard for Audit and Control.
 QUALIFICATIONS
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or Related discipline
 With at least minimum 6-8 years’ experience with a proven track record of success in Digital platform business analysis, and /or channels management, preferably in Corporate and Institutional Banking, in the cash payments and file formats specifications space, including the ability to work with data and perform in depth analysis.
 Proven track record in leading and implementing digitalization and/or transformation initiatives preferably in Corporate and Institutional Banking driving adoption of digital solutions and increasing share of revenue and/or realising cost efficiencies by leveraging digital capabilities.
 Exposure working on application integration with internal and external services, such as payment gateways, authentication systems, and third-party data providers enabled through APIs and other integration mechanisms.
 Agile methodology, good understanding of the product development lifecycle using Agile Methodology and relevant prior experience in drafting vision statements, epics and user stories, use case documents, solution papers, business workflow documents and high-level functional flows.
 Effective and positive written and verbal communications especially when acting as a liaison between departments, internal employees/subordinates and clients.
 Highly experienced in stakeholder management and working closely with global senior leaders, including business product heads, COOs and CIOs
 Agile Product Ownership certification will be a plus

 Commodities Trading Intern (or Commodity TraderIntern / Trading Analyst Intern)

 Department
 Trading / Merchandising / Risk Management /Commercial Operations
 Location
 Paya Lebar Square - Singapore
 Duration
 Typically 8–12 weeks (summer internship) or 4–6months, full-time.
 Role Overview
 As a Commodities Trading Intern, you will supportthe trading desk and commercial teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Youwill gain hands-on exposure to physical and/or financial commodity markets,market analysis, risk management, logistics, and contract execution. The roleblends analytical work, data handling, customer interaction (in some programs),and operational support. It is designed to build foundational knowledge ineconomics, supply-demand dynamics, hedging, and decision-making under uncertainty.
 This internship often serves as a pipeline tofull-time roles in trading, analytics, or operations.
 KeyResponsibilities
 Conduct market research and analysis: Monitor commodity price trends, supply and demand fundamentals, geopolitical events, weather impacts, and economic indicators.
 Analyze and compile daily/weekly market reports, charts, and dashboards (using tools like Excel, Bloomberg, or internal platforms).
 Support traders with data collection, updating trading systems, and preparing trade recommendations or risk assessments.
 Assist in contract execution: Help initiate, negotiate (under supervision), and document purchase/sale contracts, including terms for price, quantity, quality, transportation, timing, and payment.
 Coordinate logistics and operations: Track shipments, verify documents (e.g., Bills of Lading), manage scheduling, and support portfolio optimization.
 Participate in risk management activities: Help monitor positions, calculate exposures, and assist with hedging strategies using futures, options, or swaps.
 Build and maintain relationships: Interact with internal teams (e.g., accountants, operations) and, in some programs, external stakeholders such as producers, elevators, mills, end-users, or processors.
 Work on special projects: Examples include back-testing trading strategies, data visualization (Power BI, Spotfire, etc.), supply chain analysis, or market fundamentals modeling.
 Shadow experienced traders and merchandisers to understand real-time decision-making in volatile markets.
 Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and risk limits.
 Daily tasks often include monitoring news feeds,updating spreadsheets, attending team meetings, and contributing to deal flow or reporting.
 RequiredQualifications & Skills
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Agricultural Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (preferably junior/senior status or recent graduate).
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts) is essential; knowledge of Python, R, SQL, or data visualization tools is a plus.
 Basic understanding of financial markets, derivatives (futures/options), and/or physical commodity supply chains.
 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for preparing reports and interacting with teams.
 High attention to detail, ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment, and strong problem-solving abilities.
 Team player with a proactive, results-oriented attitude and eagerness to learn.
 Availability for full-time commitment during the internship period; some roles may require occasional overtime during market volatility.
 PreferredQualifications
 Prior internship or coursework in trading, risk management, logistics, or agriculture/energy markets.
 Familiarity with commodities (energy, metals, ags) or trading platforms.
 Language skills (e.g., Mandarin, English, Malay, Tamil) for international trading desks.
 Knowledge of statistical modeling or programming for quantitative roles.
 What You WillGain
 Deep exposure to global commodity markets and trading strategies.
 Practical understanding of risk, logistics, and commercial decision-making.
 Networking opportunities with industry professionals.
 Potential pathway to full-time employment upon successful completion.

 Your Impact
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive intern who is passionate about making a difference. In this role, you will be the backbone of our Employer Partnerships and Placement (EPP) team, directly contributing to our mission by connecting our bootcamp graduates with their next career opportunity.  Compile feedback, and document processes to help us improve continuously.

 Go Beyond the Job Description
